6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Tangent.TruncExpCechTransport
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LaurentTwoChartCoboundary
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.TwoChartCechPicTrivial
9	
10	/-!
11	# The algebra→scheme seam for two-chart ℙ¹ coboundaries
12	
13	The pure-algebra layer (`Picard/LaurentTwoChartCoboundary.lean` and the `Algebra/Laurent*`
14	files) characterises `laurentCoboundaryUnits A`, the coboundary subgroup of the abstract
15	two-chart datum `Polynomial.toLaurent`, `rightChart A` on the Laurent overlap ring
16	`LaurentPolynomial A`.  A scheme consumer of `Scheme.cechPic_eq_one_of_forall_presenting_coboundary`
17	instead holds `Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits V`, the coboundary subgroup of the scheme
18	restriction maps `X.resHom` on `Γ(X, V₀ ⊓ V₁)ˣ`.
19	
20	Both are literally `TruncExpCech.cechCoboundaryUnits` of the respective restriction ring homs
21	(`Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits` unfolds to it by definition, `LaurentTwoChartCoboundary.lean`
22	and `TwoChartCechPicTrivial.lean:71`).  So an **identification of the two data** — ring
23	isomorphisms of the two chart section rings with `A[t]` and of the overlap section ring with
24	`A[T;T⁻¹]`, intertwining the scheme restrictions with `toLaurent`/`rightChart` — transports
25	coboundary membership between them.  This file is that seam: it consumes the identification as
26	hypotheses (the base-changed `ℙ¹_A` two-chart cover that realises them is the remaining scheme
27	build) and hands back the scheme-side `twoChartCoboundaryUnits` membership the criterion wants.
28	
29	Nothing here assumes the identifying isomorphisms are anything in particular, and nothing here
30	uses a new hypothesis on the ring `A`: it is the naturality of `cechCoboundaryUnits`
31	(`TruncExpCech.mem_cechCoboundaryUnits_map_iff`) instantiated at the two Laurent chart maps.
32	
33	## Main declarations
34	
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mem_twoChartCoboundaryUnits_iff_laurent` — given the chart identification
36	  data, a scheme overlap unit is in `twoChartCoboundaryUnits V` iff its `A[T;T⁻¹]ˣ` image is in
37	  `laurentCoboundaryUnits A`.
38	-/
39	
40	set_option autoImplicit false
41	
42	universe u
43	
44	open CategoryTheory
45	
46	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
47	
48	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : Bool → X.Opens}
49	
50	/-- **The algebra→scheme coboundary seam.**
51	
52	Suppose the two-chart cover `V` of `X` is Laurent-identified over `A`: ring isomorphisms
53	`γ₀ : Γ(X, V false) ≃+* A[t]`, `γ₁ : Γ(X, V true) ≃+* A[t]` of the two chart section rings and
54	`γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) ≃+* A[T;T⁻¹]` of the overlap section ring, intertwining the
55	scheme restrictions `X.resHom` with the two Laurent chart maps
56	(`Polynomial.toLaurent`, `rightChart A`):
57	
58	* `hres₀ : γ₀₁ ∘ resHom(inf_le_left) = toLaurent ∘ γ₀`;
59	* `hres₁ : γ₀₁ ∘ resHom(inf_le_right) = rightChart A ∘ γ₁`.
60	
61	Then a scheme overlap unit `u : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true)ˣ` is a two-chart coboundary iff its
62	image `Units.map γ₀₁ u : (A[T;T⁻¹])ˣ` is a Laurent coboundary.  Composed with the landed
63	`mem_laurentCoboundaryUnits_iff_general`, this reads the scheme-side coboundary condition off
64	the exponent-zero normal form of the transported Laurent unit — with no new hypothesis. -/
65	theorem mem_twoChartCoboundaryUnits_iff_laurent
66	    (γ₀ : Γ(X, V false) ≃+* Polynomial A) (γ₁ : Γ(X, V true) ≃+* Polynomial A)
67	    (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) ≃+* LaurentPolynomial A)
68	    (hres₀ : (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
69	        (X.resHom (inf_le_left : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V false))
70	      = (Polynomial.toLaurent : Polynomial A →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
71	        (γ₀ : Γ(X, V false) →+* Polynomial A))
72	    (hres₁ : (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
73	        (X.resHom (inf_le_right : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V true))
74	      = (rightChart A).comp (γ₁ : Γ(X, V true) →+* Polynomial A))
75	    (u : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true)ˣ) :
76	    u ∈ Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits V
77	      ↔ Units.map (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) →+* LaurentPolynomial A).toMonoidHom u
78	          ∈ laurentCoboundaryUnits A := by
79	  have h :=
80	    TruncExpCech.mem_cechCoboundaryUnits_map_iff
81	      (X.resHom (inf_le_left : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V false))
82	      (X.resHom (inf_le_right : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V true))
83	      (Polynomial.toLaurent : Polynomial A →+* LaurentPolynomial A) (rightChart A)
84	      γ₀ γ₁ γ₀₁ hres₀ hres₁ u
85	  exact h.symm
86	
87	end AlgebraicGeometry
